notes.title: An update from the Beavers be Dammed team!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31519609/e650ddfe4f9313755fb093b9f3ee47b9ddc6463f.jpg[/img]
Hello beavers, hoomans and otter animals,

We wanted to give you an update on our progress, plans for the future and the current state of the game and team working on it.

As you might have noticed things have slowed down over the past few weeks and we want to be as open as possible about the reasons why. Most of you know Beavers be Dammed started out as a school project which, as all good things tend to do, has come to an end. This means all six of us have moved on from working 40 hours a week (and most weeks even more) on the game to working towards our graduation. 

This means we have to find a new workflow that allows us to work on distance from each other while still making progress and keeping each other up to date. So far we noticed this is harder than we though it would be.

The next update will include an options menu, key binding and the option to press the button to hold the log once instead of having to hold it (this will will help players currently having problems with key ghosting while playing on a keyboard). The next update will also fix some known bugs and feature other small improvements.

After this we are going to work on beaver customization and redo the level progression. We are currently investigating a system in which successfully completing a level will unlock the next and stars are used to unlock hats and possibly other fun things for your beavers.

In the meantime we will also be working on new levels and obstacles as well as looking into the most requested feature so far: online multiplayer.

Last but not least we want thank all of you guys for playing our game and sharing it with your friends. We do our best to make Beavers be Dammed the best game we possibly can and your support and feedback has been extremely valuable. So don’t hesitate to send us a message if you have an idea or feedback. 

Thank you for your understanding and we promise we will do our best to keep these long, serious posts without puns to a minimum.

Woodbye!


The Beavers be Dammed Team

notes.title: Beavers Be Dammed update 1: 4 new levels, an intro animation and more!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31519609/62723ab0887744e25232298116f7c1ea80f7b40d.png[/img]

Dear beavers, hoomans and otter animals,

The morning smells like wood, which can only mean one thing: [i]today is a tree-riffic day[/i]. Beavers Be Dammed has been updated! The update contains [b]four new levels[/b] full of dangerous lasers. Aside four new crazily fun levels, the game now also contains [b]an introductory animation[/b] that will show you why our beavers started stealing in the first place. Of course, the update also features a few QoL features such as Steam Cloud Save support and numerous bug fixes.

As always, have fun stealing.

Thank you,

Harry Beaver

notes.title: Beavers Be Dammed Early Access is now also available on Linux!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31519609/c8d776ec30615d493ff609b9487c89ea3f8d0103.png[/img]


Dear beavers and otter animals,

Today, we have good news for the penguins among animals. We were able to create a Linux build and test it on a Linux machine with Ubuntu, which means as of now the Beavers Be Dammed Early Access is also fully playable with the same features as any other OS on Linux distributions.

Please provide us with feedback, positive or negative, on our Community Hub or as a review :)

Please let us know if other distributions than Ubuntu work or not, if not, we will try to fix problems ASAP!

Have fun penguins,

Harry Beaver

notes.title: Beavers Be Dammed Early Access Announcement
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31519609/c8d776ec30615d493ff609b9487c89ea3f8d0103.png[/img]

Dear beavers and otter animal friends,

Today is a gnawesome day. I am eager to announce that Beavers Be Dammed will be entering [b]Steam Early Access[/b] this monday, 15 January 2018.

Get together with a beaver friend for eight levels of beaver goodness expanding upon the [b]WOODCAMP[/b] Closed Beta with four levels full of fiery flames featuring an all new original Beavers Be Dammed soundtrack! Steal your way through the mills to progress & unlock levels and keep them synced between computers with Steam Cloud integration. Last but not least, the Early Access version will also include a completely reworked UI and polish. Not to forget about a complete UI rework and polished existing features.

The reason we chose to enter Early Access with Beavers Be Dammed is because we, as a team of six students, want to improve and expand upon our game in tight collaboration with the community. The future of the game is going to be defined by your feedback.

The Early Access version of this game will stay live until at least the August 2018. During Early Access we hope to polish existing features and create new content up to at least around 30 levels and new features such as Steam Achievements in collaboration with you.

The Early Access version will be free upon launch and will either become priced and/or have priced features after Early Access.

We hope that together with you, the players, we will be able to make Beavers Be Dammed even more fun for all beavers, and otter animals alike.

Sincerely,


Harry Beaver

[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31519609/a39ae7e328cafdaf3d55c222a48c348d69166a49.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31519609/45b3d33bd11d9dcaf632f189de8a8f85ba56932e.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: The Beavers Be Dammed WOODCAMP Closed Beta event is live!
notes.content:
Dear beavers and otter animals,

Today smells like morning wood to my nose, which means it is yet another tree-riffic day. I am pleased to announced that the Beavers Be Dammed [b]WOODCAMP Closed Beta event[/b] has just started! Beavers who enrolled have just been mailed instructions including a STEAM code which can be used to play the closed beta.

The WOODCAMP consists of four levels that we use to train our beavers to get them ready for the real deal of stealing wood! Quickly get to the WOODCAMP instructions e-mailed to you to start your training.

[i]Please leave feedback, positive or negative, on our STEAM community page and/or social media pages. We, a team of six students, need your feedback to improve upon our game! Thank you very much for your help and interest in Beavers Be Dammed.[/i]

[b]Have you forgotten to enroll into our WOODCAMP but wood you still like to become a thieving beaver? Luckily for you, we are expanding our forces even more, so enroll and instructions including a STEAM key will be sent to you soon.[/b]

[url=http://www.beaversbedammed.com/]SIGN UP HERE![/url]

Sincerely,

Harry Beaver

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31519609/62723ab0887744e25232298116f7c1ea80f7b40d.png[/img]

Dear beavers and hoomans,

Today is a tree-riffic day. The Beavers Be Dammed Steam page is live for all beavers, hoomans and otter animals to see. We are happy to announce that our game Beavers Be Dammed will be available to you early 2018 on Windows and OS X via Steam!

If you can’t wait and want in on the action early, make sure you’ll signup for our Woodcamp. This will give you access to the beta of Beavers be Dammed. You can signup [url=http://www.beaversbedammed.com]here[/url]. Signup is due 29 December 2018, so be quick!

The game is being actively developed by a team of six students. Currently, Beavers Be Dammed is seven weeks in development and we are proud to show you what we’ve got. Let us know what you think and how you think we van improve the game in the Community Hub. We wood like to hear from you! 

Sincerely,

Wallflower Games
